title: Build graph and cache
description: Practice build graph and cache with a local package graph or manifests, an intentionally failing starter and independent Node tests without cloud deployments.
objectives: Explain build graph and cache through an explicit package/graph contract
Reproduce the broken workspace/build policy using offline inputs
Verify corrected boundaries with local Node/TypeScript tests and state what requires pnpm or turbo
rubric: I identify the real build graph and cache configuration or graph risk.
I demonstrate a failing starter and correct local behavior.
I distinguish a static model from an actual pnpm/Turborepo installation or build.
